div.head: Swer 8
div.ab: On ælmihtiges Godes naman, swa ic her N. on soðre gewitnesse stande, unabeden ⁊ ungeboht to, swa ic hit minum egum oferseah ⁊ minum earum oferhyrde, ðæt ðæt ic him mid sæcge.

Hu se sceal swerigean, ðe mid oðre on gewitnesse standeð. On ealmihtiges Godes naman, swa ic her Ñ on soðre gewitnosse stande, unabeden ⁊ ungeboht to, swa ic hit minum egum oferseah ⁊ minum earum oferhyrde, þæt þæt ic him mid secge.

In omnipotentis Dei nomine, sic asto N. in uero testimonio unabeden ⁊ unaboht to (id est non rogatus uel ad hoc conductus), sicut oculis meis superuidi et meis auribus hoc superaudiui, quod cum eo dico.

(Wie dér schwören soll, welcher in Zeugenschaft einem andern beisteht. B). Im Namen des allmächtigen Gottes, só stehe ich hier [bei] dem N. in wahrer Zeugenschaft, unaufgefordert und nicht dazu erkauft, wie ich es mit meinen Augen sah und mit meinen Ohren hörte, das was ich mit ihm aussage.

(How he shall swear who stands with another as a witness. B) In the name of almighty God, so do I stand here [by] N. in true witness, unbidden and unbought, as I saw with my eyes and heard with my ears that which I declare with him.
[I swear] in the name of Almighty God [that] you vowed that [the sale] was honest and true, and what you sold me was proof against future claims as was witnessed [by another] in our presence: N.
